execute:

---

```{=html}
<style>
/* FERTISA | Diseño responsivo | Tipografía: Times New Roman */
:root {
  --fertisa-navy: #174675;
  --fertisa-border: #c9e0f5;
  --fertisa-text: #143f70;
  --sidebar-width: clamp(218px, 16.15vw, 250px);
  --header-height: clamp(84px, 10.7vh, 110px);
  --kpi-height: clamp(76px, 9.2vh, 95px);
  --glossary-height: clamp(150px, 18.2vh, 186px);
  --footer-height: clamp(68px, 8.7vh, 90px);
  --ui-gap: clamp(8px, 1.05vh, 12px);
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body {
  margin: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important; min-height: 100%;
  background: #f3f8fd !important; color: var(--fertisa-text) !important;
  font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif !important;
}
body, body * { font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif !important; }
#quarto-content, .page-columns, main.content, .page-layout-full main.content {
  margin: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important; width: 100% !important; max-width: none !important;
}
header#title-block-header, .quarto-title-block, #title-block-header { display: none !important; }
.cell:has(.fertisa-app), .cell-output:has(.fertisa-app), .cell-output-display:has(.fertisa-app) {
  margin: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important; width: 100% !important; max-width: none !important;
}

/* ---------- Estructura global (columnas/filas explícitas, sin grid-areas) ---------- */
.fertisa-app {
  position: fixed !important; inset: 0 !important; z-index: 9999 !important;
  width: 100vw !important; height: 100vh !important; height: 100dvh !important;
  margin: 0 !important; padding: 0 !important;
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: var(--sidebar-width) minmax(0, 1fr) !important;
  grid-template-rows: var(--header-height) minmax(0, 1fr) !important;
  background: #f3f8fd; overflow: hidden !important;
}
.fertisa-sidebar { grid-column: 1 !important; grid-row: 1 / span 2 !important; }
.fertisa-topbar  { grid-column: 2 !important; grid-row: 1 !important; }
.fertisa-content { grid-column: 2 !important; grid-row: 2 !important; }

/* ---------- Barra lateral ---------- */
.fertisa-sidebar {
  position: relative; min-width: 0; height: 100%;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  padding: clamp(12px, 1.15vw, 18px) clamp(11px, .9vw, 15px) 18px;
  color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #214f81 0%, #174675 66%, #153f6b 100%);
  border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18); overflow: hidden; z-index: 5;
}
.fertisa-sidebar::before {
  content: ""; position: absolute; left: -28%; right: -18%; bottom: 70px; height: 245px;
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(94,151,204,.30), rgba(15,53,93,.02));
  clip-path: polygon(0 12%, 24% 28%, 49% 62%, 70% 74%, 100% 48%, 100% 100%, 0 100%);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.sidebar-brand-panel {
  position: relative; z-index: 1; flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  width: 100%; min-height: clamp(69px, 8vw, 88px); padding: 7px 9px;
  background: #fff; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(6,34,64,.12);
}
.sidebar-logo { display: block; width: 100%; max-width: 188px; height: auto; object-fit: contain; }
.sidebar-section-title {
  position: relative; z-index: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px;
  margin: clamp(16px, 1.8vh, 23px) 6px clamp(13px, 1.7vh, 19px);
  color: #fff; font-size: clamp(13px, .92vw, 15px); line-height: 1.15; font-weight: 700;
}
.sidebar-section-title svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.sidebar-filters { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: clamp(12px, 1.7vh, 18px); }
.fertisa-sidebar .form-group { margin: 0 !important; }
.fertisa-sidebar label, .fertisa-sidebar .control-label {
  display: block; margin: 0 0 5px !important; color: #fff !important;
  font-size: clamp(13px, .86vw, 15px) !important; line-height: 1.15 !important; font-weight: 700 !important;
}
.fertisa-sidebar .form-select, .fertisa-sidebar select, .fertisa-sidebar .selectize-input {
  width: 100% !important; min-height: clamp(38px, 4.25vh, 44px) !important; padding: 7px 10px !important;
  color: #164576 !important; background: #fff !important; border: 1px solid #d1e4f5 !important;
  border-radius: 7px !important; box-shadow: none !important; font-size: clamp(13px, .88vw, 15px) !important;
}
.fertisa-sidebar .selectize-input { display: flex !important; align-items: center !important; }
#limpiar_filtros {
  width: 100% !important; min-height: clamp(39px, 4.5vh, 46px) !important; margin: 0 !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55) !important; border-radius: 7px !important;
  background: #e6f1fb !important; color: #194c7e !important; font-weight: 700 !important;
  font-size: clamp(13px, .87vw, 15px) !important; box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(10,38,67,.12) !important;
}
#limpiar_filtros:hover { background: #fff !important; }
#limpiar_filtros .button-label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; }
#limpiar_filtros .button-label svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; }
.sidebar-bottom { position: relative; z-index: 1; margin-top: auto; padding: 12px 8px 3px; text-align: center; }
.sidebar-ship { display: block; width: clamp(70px, 5.8vw, 92px); margin: 0 auto 10px; color: #80b6e7; }
.sidebar-ship svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }
.sidebar-tagline { color: rgba(255,255,255,.94); font-size: clamp(12px, .9vw, 15px); line-height: 1.22; }

/* ---------- Encabezado ---------- */
.fertisa-topbar {
  position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; min-width: 0;
  padding: 10px clamp(18px, 2vw, 32px); overflow: hidden;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f5f9fd, #edf6fc); border-bottom: 1px solid #d5e7f6;
}
.fertisa-topbar::before {
  content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none;
  background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(244,249,253,1) 0%, rgba(244,249,253,.99) 31%, rgba(244,249,253,.82) 50%, rgba(244,249,253,.08) 76%), var(--port-photo);
  background-size: 100% 100%; background-position: right center; background-repeat: no-repeat;
}
.topbar-copy { position: relative; z-index: 1; border-left: 3px solid #2a6097; padding-left: clamp(10px, 1vw, 15px); }
.topbar-title { margin: 0; color: #174b83; font-size: clamp(21px, 1.7vw, 28px); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.1; }
.topbar-subtitle { margin-top: 5px; color: #214f81; font-size: clamp(13px, 1vw, 17px); line-height: 1.1; }
.topbar-dot { margin: 0 7px; color: #4075aa; }

/* ---------- Contenido ---------- */
.fertisa-content {
  min-width: 0; min-height: 0; display: grid !important; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) !important;
  grid-template-rows: var(--kpi-height) minmax(0, 1fr) var(--glossary-height) var(--footer-height) !important;
  gap: var(--ui-gap); padding: clamp(9px, 1.05vw, 17px) clamp(10px, 1.05vw, 17px) 0;
  overflow-x: hidden !important; overflow-y: auto !important; background: #f4f9fd;
}
.fertisa-kpi-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: clamp(8px, .8vw, 13px); min-width: 0; min-height: 0; }
.kpi-card {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: clamp(10px, .9vw, 15px); min-width: 0; height: 100%;
  padding: clamp(9px, .9vw, 14px) clamp(10px, 1.05vw, 17px); border: 1px solid var(--fertisa-border);
  border-radius: 10px; background: linear-gradient(120deg, #fff 0%, #f8fbfe 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(26,79,128,.08); overflow: hidden;
}
.kpi-card.kpi-primary { color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(115deg, #2b64a1 0%, #1d548e 100%); border-color: #2b64a1; }
.kpi-icon {
  display: flex; flex: 0 0 clamp(48px, 4.5vw, 66px); width: clamp(48px, 4.5vw, 66px); height: clamp(48px, 4.5vw, 66px);
  align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #20568e; background: #e6f1fb; border-radius: 50%;
}
.kpi-primary .kpi-icon { color: #1f5992; background: #fff; }
.kpi-icon svg { width: 53%; height: 53%; display: block; }
.kpi-copy { min-width: 0; flex: 1 1 auto; }
.kpi-title { margin: 0 0 5px; color: #174675; font-size: clamp(12px, .83vw, 14px); line-height: 1.12; font-weight: 700; }
.kpi-primary .kpi-title, .kpi-primary .kpi-value { color: #fff; }
.kpi-value { color: #164d85; font-size: clamp(21px, 1.55vw, 28px); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.05; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.kpi-value .shiny-text-output { display: inline !important; }

/* ---------- Paneles ---------- */
.fertisa-workspace {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, .95fr) minmax(0, 1.05fr);
  grid-template-rows: minmax(210px, 1fr) minmax(230px, 1fr); gap: var(--ui-gap); min-height: 0; min-width: 0;
}
.fertisa-panel {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden;
  background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--fertisa-border); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(25,79,128,.08);
}
.panel-chart { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
.panel-documents { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; }
.panel-detail { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / span 2; }
.panel-heading {
  flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: clamp(32px, 3.15vh, 37px);
  padding: 5px clamp(11px, .95vw, 15px); color: #174b83;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #e3eff9 0%, #eff6fc 100%); border-bottom: 1px solid #d5e7f6;
  font-size: clamp(14px, .98vw, 16px); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.15;
}
.panel-body { flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; min-width: 0; padding: clamp(5px, .55vw, 8px); overflow: hidden; }
.panel-chart .panel-body { display: flex; align-items: stretch; justify-content: stretch; padding: 2px 6px 5px; }
.chart-plot-holder { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; }
.chart-plot-holder .shiny-plot-output { width: 100% !important; height: 100% !important; min-height: 0 !important; }
.panel-detail .panel-body, .panel-documents .panel-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }

/* ---------- DataTables ---------- */
.dataTables_wrapper, .dt-container {
  width: 100% !important; max-width: 100% !important; min-width: 0 !important;
  color: #173f6c !important; font-size: clamp(11px, .77vw, 13px) !important;
}
.dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_filter, .dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_length,
.dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_info, .dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_paginate,
.dt-container .dt-search, .dt-container .dt-length, .dt-container .dt-info, .dt-container .dt-paging {
  color: #173f6c !important; font-size: clamp(11px, .76vw, 13px) !important;
}
.dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_filter input, .dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_length select,
.dt-container .dt-search input, .dt-container .dt-length select {
  border: 1px solid #c8dff3 !important; border-radius: 5px !important; background: #fff !important;
  color: #174675 !important; min-height: 27px !important; padding: 3px 7px !important; margin-left: 5px !important;
}
table.dataTable {
  width: 100% !important; max-width: 100% !important; margin: 0 !important;
  border-collapse: separate !important; border-spacing: 0 !important; table-layout: fixed !important;
  color: #183f6b !important; font-size: clamp(11px, .76vw, 13px) !important; background: #fff !important;
}
table.dataTable thead th, table.dataTable thead td {
  background: #e1eef9 !important; color: #123e70 !important; border-bottom: 1px solid #c7dff3 !important;
  border-top: 0 !important; font-weight: 700 !important; line-height: 1.15 !important;
  padding: 7px 20px 7px 6px !important;            /* espacio a la derecha para el icono de orden */
  white-space: normal !important; overflow-wrap: break-word !important; vertical-align: middle !important;
}
table.dataTable tbody td {
  padding: 4px 7px !important; line-height: 1.2 !important; border-top: 1px solid #e0edf7 !important;
  color: #143e6b !important; white-space: normal !important; overflow-wrap: anywhere !important; vertical-align: middle !important;
}
table.dataTable tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: #eef6fc !important; }
table.dataTable tbody tr:nth-child(odd)  { background: #fff !important; }
table.dataTable tbody tr:hover { background: #dcebf8 !important; }
table.dataTable thead .sorting:before, table.dataTable thead .sorting:after,
table.dataTable thead .sorting_asc:before, table.dataTable thead .sorting_asc:after,
table.dataTable thead .sorting_desc:before, table.dataTable thead .sorting_desc:after { color: #7193b5 !important; opacity: .55 !important; right: 5px !important; }

/* FIX filas vacías: la cabecera clonada dentro del cuerpo con scroll se colapsa */
.dataTables_scrollBody thead tr, .dt-scroll-body thead tr { height: 0 !important; }
.dataTables_scrollBody thead th, .dataTables_scrollBody thead td,
.dt-scroll-body thead th, .dt-scroll-body thead td {
  height: 0 !important; padding-top: 0 !important; padding-bottom: 0 !important; border: 0 !important; line-height: 0 !important;
}
.dataTables_scrollBody thead *, .dt-scroll-body thead * { visibility: collapse !important; height: 0 !important; }

.dataTables_scroll, .dataTables_scrollHead, .dataTables_scrollBody { max-width: 100% !important; }
.dataTables_scrollBody { overflow-x: hidden !important; border-bottom: 1px solid #d5e6f4 !important; }
.dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_filter { padding: 1px 0 6px; }
.dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_length { padding: 0 0 6px; }
.dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_info { padding-top: 8px !important; white-space: normal !important; }
.dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_paginate { padding-top: 6px !important; }
.dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_paginate .paginate_button {
  padding: 3px 7px !important; border-radius: 4px !important; border: 1px solid transparent !important; color: #174675 !important;
}
.dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_paginate .paginate_button.current,
.dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_paginate .paginate_button.current:hover {
  background: #245992 !important; border-color: #245992 !important; color: #fff !important;
}
.dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_paginate .paginate_button:hover { background: #e2eff9 !important; border-color: #c8dff3 !important; color: #174675 !important; }
.panel-documents table.dataTable thead th { padding: 5px 20px 5px 6px !important; }
.panel-documents table.dataTable tbody td { padding: 4px 6px !important; }

/* ---------- Glosario ---------- */
.fertisa-glossary {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--fertisa-border); border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(25,79,128,.08);
}
.glossary-heading {
  flex: 0 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: clamp(30px, 3.05vh, 36px);
  padding: 5px clamp(11px, .95vw, 15px); color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #245992 0%, #3778b4 100%);
  font-size: clamp(13px, .9vw, 15px); line-height: 1.1; font-weight: 700;
}
.glossary-heading svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.glossary-body { flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding: 6px clamp(12px, 1vw, 17px) 7px; }
.glosario-grid {
  height: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); grid-template-rows: repeat(7, minmax(0, 1fr));
  column-gap: clamp(16px, 2.1vw, 34px); row-gap: 1px;
}
.glosario-item { min-width: 0; color: #254d79; font-size: clamp(11px, .74vw, 12.5px); line-height: 1.1; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.glosario-item strong { color: #143e6d; font-weight: 700; }
.glosario-item:nth-child(3n + 2), .glosario-item:nth-child(3n + 3) { border-left: 1px solid #b9d5ee; padding-left: clamp(10px, 1vw, 16px); }

/* ---------- Pie (texto blanco, legible sobre la franja azul) ---------- */
.fertisa-footer {
  position: relative; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 14px; padding: 10px clamp(12px, 1.4vw, 22px); overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate;
  background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(241,248,253,.42), rgba(232,244,253,.30)), var(--footer-photo);
  background-size: cover; background-position: center 55%; border-radius: 2px;
}
.fertisa-footer::before {
  content: ""; position: absolute; z-index: -1; left: -2%; right: -2%; bottom: -2px; height: 70%;
  background: linear-gradient(105deg, rgba(27,75,124,.96), rgba(70,133,192,.91));
  clip-path: polygon(0 38%, 12% 6%, 31% 48%, 51% 84%, 71% 70%, 86% 31%, 100% 14%, 100% 100%, 0 100%);
}
.footer-main-label, .footer-values {
  position: relative; z-index: 1; color: #fff; font-size: clamp(11px, .76vw, 12.5px); line-height: 1.1;
  font-weight: 700; text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(5,30,60,.6); padding-bottom: 3px;
}
.footer-values { text-align: right; font-weight: 400; }
.footer-dot { padding: 0 7px; color: #d7eaff; }

/* ---------- Pantallas bajas ---------- */
@media (max-width: 1250px) and (min-width: 1051px) {
  :root { --sidebar-width: 218px; }
  .kpi-card { padding: 8px 10px; gap: 9px; }
  .kpi-icon { flex-basis: 47px; width: 47px; height: 47px; }
  .kpi-title { font-size: 12px; }
}
@media (min-width: 1051px) {
  html, body { height: 100% !important; overflow: hidden !important; }
}
@media (max-height: 900px) and (min-width: 1051px) {
  :root { --kpi-height: clamp(70px, 8.45vh, 78px); --glossary-height: clamp(142px, 16.5vh, 153px); --footer-height: clamp(64px, 7.8vh, 72px); --ui-gap: 8px; }
  .fertisa-content { grid-template-rows: var(--kpi-height) minmax(430px, 1fr) var(--glossary-height) var(--footer-height) !important; padding-top: 10px; }
  .fertisa-workspace { grid-template-rows: minmax(200px, 1fr) minmax(220px, 1fr); }
  .panel-heading { min-height: 30px; }
}

/* ---------- Tablet / móvil: se libera el scroll de toda la página ---------- */
@media (max-width: 1050px) {
  html, body { height: auto !important; overflow: auto !important; }
  .fertisa-app {
    position: static !important; inset: auto !important; width: 100% !important; height: auto !important;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) !important; grid-template-rows: auto auto auto !important; overflow: visible !important;
  }
  .fertisa-topbar  { grid-column: 1 !important; grid-row: 1 !important; min-height: var(--header-height); }
  .fertisa-sidebar {
    grid-column: 1 !important; grid-row: 2 !important; height: auto; padding: 10px 14px;
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(130px, 180px) repeat(2, minmax(130px, 1fr)) minmax(130px, 160px);
    align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  }
  .fertisa-content { grid-column: 1 !important; grid-row: 3 !important; height: auto !important; grid-template-rows: auto auto auto auto !important; overflow: visible !important; }
  .sidebar-brand-panel { min-height: 56px; }
  .sidebar-section-title, .sidebar-bottom { display: none; }
  .sidebar-filters { display: contents; }
  .fertisa-sidebar label { font-size: 12px !important; }
  #limpiar_filtros { min-height: 38px !important; align-self: end; }
  .fertisa-kpi-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); grid-auto-rows: 78px; }
  .fertisa-workspace { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-rows: minmax(310px, auto) minmax(440px, auto) minmax(290px, auto); }
  .panel-chart { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
  .panel-detail { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; }
  .panel-documents { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 3; }
  .glosario-grid { min-height: 145px; }
  .fertisa-footer { min-height: 75px; }
}
@media (max-width: 620px) {
  .fertisa-sidebar { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .sidebar-brand-panel { width: 180px; justify-self: center; }
  .sidebar-section-title { display: flex; margin: 5px 0; }
  .sidebar-filters { display: flex; }
  #limpiar_filtros { align-self: stretch; }
  .fertisa-topbar { padding: 10px 14px; }
  .topbar-title { font-size: 20px; }
  .topbar-subtitle { font-size: 13px; }
  .fertisa-content { padding: 10px; }
  .fertisa-kpi-grid { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); grid-auto-rows: 72px; }
  .kpi-icon { flex-basis: 47px; width: 47px; height: 47px; }
  .glosario-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); grid-template-rows: none; grid-auto-rows: minmax(20px, auto); }
  .glosario-item:nth-child(3n + 2), .glosario-item:nth-child(3n + 3) { border-left: 0; padding-left: 0; }
  .glosario-item:nth-child(even) { border-left: 1px solid #b9d5ee; padding-left: 10px; }
  .fertisa-glossary { min-height: 240px; }
  .fertisa-footer { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; }
  .footer-main-label, .footer-values { width: 100%; text-align: left; }
}

</style>
```

```{r}
#| context: setup

library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)
library(htmltools)

options(shiny.useragg = TRUE)

# ---------- Carpeta del QMD ----------
directorio_qmd <- tryCatch(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE), error = function(e) "")
if (is.null(directorio_qmd) || !nzchar(directorio_qmd)) directorio_qmd <- getwd()
# knitr::current_input(dir=TRUE) devuelve la ruta del archivo; nos quedamos con su carpeta
if (file.exists(directorio_qmd) && !dir.exists(directorio_qmd)) directorio_qmd <- dirname(directorio_qmd)

buscar_ruta <- function(...) {
  candidatas <- unique(c(file.path(directorio_qmd, ...), file.path(getwd(), ...)))
  existentes <- candidatas[file.exists(candidatas)]
  if (!length(existentes)) {
    stop("No se encontró ", file.path(...), ".\nSe buscó en:\n- ",
         paste(candidatas, collapse = "\n- "))
  }
  existentes[1]
}

# ---------- Imágenes ----------
# >>> PEGA AQUÍ, tal cual están en tu QMD original, los tres bloques:
#       logo_b64 <- paste0( ... )
#       port_header_b64 <- paste0( ... )
#       port_footer_b64 <- paste0( ... )
# (No pegues las líneas logo_uri / port_header_uri / port_footer_uri.)
# Si no los pegas, el reporte funciona igual, solo que sin imágenes.
# <<< FIN DEL ESPACIO PARA IMÁGENES

a_uri <- function(nombre_var) {
  if (!exists(nombre_var, inherits = TRUE)) return("")
  paste0("data:image/png;base64,", get(nombre_var))
}
# Logo: prioridad 1) logo_b64 pegado arriba, 2) archivo local assets/logo.png, 3) enlace web
logo_url <- "https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQEtWK5l_iz38pr8fPWd5zgQa_s7Yuga_cj7Vc2_56hZPdp7629jPqA1Cp4&s=10"
logo_uri <- if (exists("logo_b64", inherits = TRUE)) {
  a_uri("logo_b64")
} else if (file.exists(file.path(directorio_qmd, "assets", "logo.png"))) {
  ruta_logo <- file.path(directorio_qmd, "assets", "logo.png")
  paste0("data:image/png;base64,", jsonlite::base64_enc(readBin(ruta_logo, "raw", file.size(ruta_logo))))
} else {
  logo_url
}
port_header_uri <- a_uri("port_header_b64")
port_footer_uri <- a_uri("port_footer_b64")

# Fuente del gráfico: Times New Roman en Windows, serif genérica en otros sistemas
fuente_grafico <- if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") "Times New Roman" else "serif"

# ---------- Datos ----------
datos_iniciales <- readRDS(buscar_ruta("datos", "Base.rds"))

columnas_obligatorias <- c("DEPARTAMENTO", "PROVEEDOR", "DOCUMENTO", "TIENE_DOCUMENTO", "ESTADO")
columnas_faltantes <- setdiff(columnas_obligatorias, names(datos_iniciales))
if (length(columnas_faltantes) > 0) {
  stop("Faltan estas columnas en Base.rds: ", paste(columnas_faltantes, collapse = ", "))
}

datos_iniciales <- datos_iniciales |>
  mutate(
    across(all_of(columnas_obligatorias), as.character),
    TIENE_DOCUMENTO = toupper(trimws(TIENE_DOCUMENTO))
  )

n_descartadas <- sum(!(datos_iniciales$TIENE_DOCUMENTO %in% c("SI", "NO")))
if (n_descartadas > 0) {
  message("Aviso: se descartaron ", n_descartadas,
          " filas con TIENE_DOCUMENTO distinto de SI/NO (incluye NA).")
}
datos_iniciales <- filter(datos_iniciales, TIENE_DOCUMENTO %in% c("SI", "NO"))

lista_departamentos <- sort(unique(na.omit(datos_iniciales$DEPARTAMENTO)))
lista_proveedores <- datos_iniciales |>
  filter(!is.na(PROVEEDOR), trimws(PROVEEDOR) != "") |>
  distinct(PROVEEDOR) |> arrange(PROVEEDOR) |> pull(PROVEEDOR)

# ---------- Iconos SVG ----------
svg_icon <- function(tipo) {
  formas <- list(
    documento = '<path d="M14 5h14l7 7v27H14z"/><path d="M28 5v8h7M19 20h11M19 26h11M19 32h8"/>',
    departamento = '<circle cx="18" cy="16" r="5"/><circle cx="31" cy="18" r="4"/><path d="M7 36c0-7 5-11 11-11s11 4 11 11z"/><path d="M28 27c6-1 11 3 12 9H31"/>',
    proveedor = '<circle cx="24" cy="15" r="7"/><path d="M10 39c0-8 5-13 14-13s14 5 14 13z"/>',
    pendientes = '<path d="M14 5h14l7 7v16M28 5v8h7M18 20h10M18 25h6"/><path d="M31 29l9 15H22z"/><path d="M31 34v4M31 41h.1"/>',
    filtro = '<path d="M6 9h36L28 23v12l-8 5V23z"/>',
    barco = '<path d="M5 32h38l-5 7H13z"/><path d="M17 32V18h14l7 14M22 18V9h8v9M25 9V5h6v4"/><path d="M7 43c4-3 7 3 11 0s7 3 11 0 7 3 11 0"/>',
    glosario = '<path d="M7 9h14c3 0 5 2 5 5v25c0-3-2-5-5-5H7z"/><path d="M41 9H27c-3 0-5 2-5 5v25c0-3 2-5 5-5h14z"/><path d="M12 16h8M12 21h8M31 16h6M31 21h6"/>'
  )
  htmltools::HTML(paste0(
    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 48 48" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" ',
    'fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">',
    formas[[tipo]], '</svg>'
  ))
}
```

```{r}
#| context: server

# ---------- Utilidades ----------
formatear_decimal <- function(x) format(round(x, 1), decimal.mark = ",", nsmall = 1, trim = TRUE)

calcular_porcentaje <- function(base) {
  if (nrow(base) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  mean(base$TIENE_DOCUMENTO == "SI", na.rm = TRUE)
}

mostrar_porcentaje <- function(valor) {
  if (length(valor) == 0 || is.na(valor)) return("Sin información")
  paste0(formatear_decimal(valor * 100), "%")
}

# ---------- Filtros ----------
# El selector de proveedor se actualiza (sin redibujarlo) según el departamento.
actualizar_proveedores <- function(departamento) {
  base <- datos_iniciales
  if (!is.null(departamento) && departamento != "TODOS") {
    base <- filter(base, DEPARTAMENTO == departamento)
  }
  provs <- base |>
    filter(!is.na(PROVEEDOR), trimws(PROVEEDOR) != "") |>
    distinct(PROVEEDOR) |> arrange(PROVEEDOR) |> pull(PROVEEDOR)
  updateSelectInput(session, "proveedor", choices = c("TODOS", provs), selected = "TODOS")
}

observeEvent(input$departamento, actualizar_proveedores(input$departamento), ignoreInit = TRUE)

observeEvent(input$limpiar_filtros, {
  updateSelectInput(session, "departamento", selected = "TODOS")
  actualizar_proveedores("TODOS")
})

datos_filtrados <- reactive({
  base <- datos_iniciales
  if (!is.null(input$departamento) && input$departamento != "TODOS") {
    base <- filter(base, DEPARTAMENTO == input$departamento)
  }
  if (!is.null(input$proveedor) && input$proveedor != "TODOS") {
    base <- filter(base, PROVEEDOR == input$proveedor)
  }
  base
})

# ---------- KPI ----------
output$kpi_general <- renderText(mostrar_porcentaje(calcular_porcentaje(datos_iniciales)))

output$kpi_departamento <- renderText({
  if (is.null(input$departamento) || input$departamento == "TODOS") return("Seleccione")
  mostrar_porcentaje(calcular_porcentaje(filter(datos_iniciales, DEPARTAMENTO == input$departamento)))
})

output$kpi_proveedor <- renderText({
  if (is.null(input$proveedor) || input$proveedor == "TODOS") return("Seleccione")
  base <- datos_iniciales
  if (!is.null(input$departamento) && input$departamento != "TODOS") {
    base <- filter(base, DEPARTAMENTO == input$departamento)
  }
  mostrar_porcentaje(calcular_porcentaje(filter(base, PROVEEDOR == input$proveedor)))
})

output$kpi_pendientes <- renderText(sum(datos_filtrados()$TIENE_DOCUMENTO == "NO", na.rm = TRUE))

# ---------- Gráfico de anillo ----------
output$titulo_grafico <- renderText({
  if (is.null(input$proveedor) || input$proveedor == "TODOS") "todos los proveedores"
  else input$proveedor
})

output$grafico_estado <- renderPlot({
  base <- datos_filtrados()
  validate(need(nrow(base) > 0, "No existen datos para la selección realizada"))

  total <- nrow(base)
  emitidos <- sum(base$TIENE_DOCUMENTO == "SI")
  pendientes <- total - emitidos
  pct_emitidos <- emitidos / total

  resumen <- data.frame(
    TIENE_DOCUMENTO = c("SI", "NO"),
    TOTAL = c(emitidos, pendientes)
  )
  resumen <- resumen[resumen$TOTAL > 0, ]

  leyenda <- c(
    sprintf("Emitidos: %d (%s%%)", emitidos, formatear_decimal(pct_emitidos * 100)),
    sprintf("Pendientes: %d (%s%%)", pendientes, formatear_decimal((1 - pct_emitidos) * 100))
  )

  # Anillo fino: ancho 0.6 sobre x = 2 => aro entre 1.7 y 2.3; el hueco llega a x = 0.4
  ggplot(resumen, aes(x = 2, y = TOTAL, fill = TIENE_DOCUMENTO)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6, color = "#FFFFFF", linewidth = 0.8) +
    coord_polar(theta = "y", start = 0) +
    xlim(0.4, 2.3) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.4, y = 0, label = paste0(formatear_decimal(pct_emitidos * 100), "%"),
             family = fuente_grafico, fontface = "bold", size = 5.2, color = "#174675") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("SI" = "#245992", "NO" = "#a9cbed"),
                      breaks = c("SI", "NO"), labels = leyenda, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(fill = NULL) +
    theme_void(base_family = fuente_grafico) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "#244e7c"),
      legend.key.size = grid::unit(.5, "cm"),
      legend.spacing.y = grid::unit(.25, "cm"),
      legend.margin = margin(0, 10, 0, 0),
      plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
    )
}, res = 96)

# ---------- Tabla: cumplimiento por documento (respeta ambos filtros) ----------
output$tabla_documentos <- DT::renderDT({
  base <- datos_filtrados()
  validate(need(nrow(base) > 0, "No existen datos para la selección realizada"))

  resumen <- base |>
    group_by(DOCUMENTO) |>
    summarise(
      Requeridos = n(),
      Presentados = sum(TIENE_DOCUMENTO == "SI"),
      Pendientes = sum(TIENE_DOCUMENTO == "NO"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(Cumpl = Presentados / Requeridos,
           Cumplimiento = paste0(formatear_decimal(Cumpl * 100), "%")) |>
    arrange(Cumpl, desc(Pendientes)) |>
    rename(Documento = DOCUMENTO) |>
    select(Documento, Requeridos, Presentados, Pendientes, Cumplimiento)

  DT::datatable(
    resumen, rownames = FALSE, filter = "none", class = "stripe hover compact",
    options = list(
      paging = FALSE, scrollY = "17vh", scrollCollapse = TRUE, autoWidth = FALSE, dom = "t",
      columnDefs = list(
        list(width = "24%", targets = 0), list(width = "17%", targets = 1),
        list(width = "19%", targets = 2), list(width = "17%", targets = 3),
        list(width = "23%", targets = 4),
        list(className = "dt-left", targets = 0),
        list(className = "dt-center", targets = 1:4)
      ),
      language = list(emptyTable = "No existen documentos", zeroRecords = "No se encontraron coincidencias")
    )
  )
}, server = FALSE)

# ---------- Tabla: detalle documental ----------
output$tabla_detalle <- DT::renderDT({
  resumen <- datos_filtrados() |>
    arrange(DEPARTAMENTO, PROVEEDOR, DOCUMENTO) |>
    select(DEPARTAMENTO, PROVEEDOR, DOCUMENTO, TIENE_DOCUMENTO, ESTADO) |>
    rename(`TIENE DOCUMENTO` = TIENE_DOCUMENTO)

  validate(need(nrow(resumen) > 0, "No existen registros para la selección realizada"))

  DT::datatable(
    resumen, rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", class = "stripe hover compact",
    options = list(
      pageLength = 15, lengthMenu = c(10, 15, 25, 50),
      scrollY = "36vh", scrollCollapse = TRUE, autoWidth = FALSE,
      columnDefs = list(
        list(width = "17%", targets = 0), list(width = "23%", targets = 1),
        list(width = "25%", targets = 2), list(width = "17%", targets = 3),
        list(width = "18%", targets = 4),
        list(className = "dt-center", targets = c(0, 3, 4)),
        list(className = "dt-left", targets = c(1, 2))
      ),
      language = list(
        search = "Buscar:", lengthMenu = "Mostrar _MENU_ registros",
        info = "Registros _START_ a _END_ de _TOTAL_", infoEmpty = "Sin registros",
        zeroRecords = "No se encontraron coincidencias",
        paginate = list(previous = "Anterior", `next` = "Siguiente", first = "Primera", last = "Última")
      )
    )
  )
}, server = FALSE)
```
